stories.title: The chilling statements of the Trappes racist shooter in custody: 'I hope I will become an example'
stories.summary: Kevin Tessier is suspected of shooting at eight people, killing one, in the Paris suburbs of Trappes and La Verrière. Le Monde reveals what he said in police custody.

stories.title: Italy evacuates few schools in second day of bomb threats
stories.summary: The day after a wave of emailed bomb threats led schools in several European countries to close, Italy closed only around 2% of schools, with Italian Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni saying a second wave of bomb threats was not 'concrete.'

entries.title: The leak didn't move the date
entries.body: Rockstar ran its Netflix Extended Look on 27 August as planned, and 19 November still stands. Take-Two, meanwhile, has served DMCA subpoenas on Microsoft, Discord, X and Google chasing the handle CyberLeek.
